historical_reviews.deepseek: The read-only query cannot validate the four source writes, omits eth1 and does not prove netmask, gateway, routing, identity or recovery.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly requires unused-address validation and an independently reachable recovery path before changing management networking.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: A static BMC configuration is a routed tuple, not an address field. IP, prefix/netmask, gateway and VLAN must be mutually valid and authorized. Reachability alone is insufficient if the address collides or lands on the wrong management segment.

original_test_intent: Configure one approved BMC LAN channel with a specific static network tuple, verify every field and same-BMC reachability, then restore the documented baseline without affecting other interfaces.
original_method: Verify channel/port/MAC/VLAN and original settings, obtain an unused IPAM-approved address/prefix/gateway tuple and alternate recovery, write one channel via a protected supported interface, read back all fields, validate ARP/routing/HTTPS/IPMI and target identity, then restore and diff every interface.
manual_activity: The network owner supplies and approves the static tuple; an operator authorizes the management change, confirms alternate access, handles recovery and owns the verdict.
required_inputs: VLAN, DNS, route and ACL expectations
Protected credentials and exact restore values
safety_requirements: Never guess channel mapping or address tuple
Prove the address unused before write
Do not rely on the old IP after mutation
Authenticate the BMC at the new address
Stop on duplicate IP, wrong VLAN/gateway or access loss
Restore the full tuple and preserve logs
agent_execution_scope: Verify mapping, baseline and IPAM tuple
Test address availability and recovery path
Apply protected static values after approval
Verify ARP, route, HTTPS/IPMI and BMC identity
engineer_actions: Approve IPAM tuple and target channel
Control recovery on conflict or access loss

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The eth0 GET is only partial evidence and cannot perform or validate source, netmask and gateway writes; it also guesses interface mapping and handles credentials unsafely.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the supported protected per-channel static mutation only with an IPAM-approved tuple and recovery, then prove complete readback, routing, target identity and baseline restoration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The 10/10-minute estimates and channel-based intent remain; separate approval is required per interface and logs stay intact.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture the original tuple, collision-check result, ordered write/readback, ARP/route/session transition and final restoration for one exact MAC/channel, including a no-change diff for all other interfaces.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds address governance, path recovery and complete tuple validation rather than displaying only IPv4Addresses.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An address readback does not prove netmask, gateway, VLAN, ACL or actual same-device reachability.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A syntactically valid tuple can still route management onto the wrong network; VLAN and ACL evidence must accompany connectivity.

project_override_considerations: The Project must validate the source's eth0/eth1 channel claim and provide the exact intended tuple. Retaining the tested tuple instead of restoring baseline requires a separately approved production change.
expected_evidence: Approved channel/MAC, IPAM tuple, VLAN/ACL/DNS/route and original baseline
Unused-address/conflict check and alternate recovery proof
Protected static writes and complete field readback
ARP/route/HTTPS/IPMI timeline with exact BMC identity
Restored all-interface baseline and no-unrelated-change diff
Preserved audit/network logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently specify static LAN configuration. Missing address values and unverified mapping are normal required inputs, not conflicting scopes.

blocked_analysis.analysis: IPAM tuple, mapping, recovery and restore data are requestable prerequisites; execution blocks only if they cannot be established safely.

review_improvement: Replaces a narrow read-only eth0 query with an IPAM-governed, full-tuple network transition and recoverable restoration contract.
independent_technical_reasoning: Static management reachability depends on a coherent layer-2 and layer-3 tuple. A correct IP with a wrong prefix can appear locally reachable while the gateway fails, and a duplicate address can connect to another device. Exact MAC/BMC identity, conflict detection and route/ACL validation prevent those false positives, while full restoration protects later remote access.
